  # generated by datamodel-codegen:
  #   filename:  session-directional-producers.json
  
  from __future__ import annotations
  from pydantic import BaseModel, RootModel
  from typing import List
  
  
  class ARequest(BaseModel):
      name: str
      secret: str
  
  
  class AResponse(BaseModel):
      id: int
      name: str
  
  
  class BRequest(BaseModel):
      name: str
      secret: str
  
  
  class BResponse(BaseModel):
      id: int
      name: str
  
  
  class ArrayRequest(RootModel[List[ARequest]]):
      root: List[ARequest]
  
  
  class ArrayResponse(RootModel[List[AResponse]]):
      root: List[AResponse]
  
  
  class BaseRequest(BaseModel):
      secret: str
  
  
  class BaseResponse(BaseModel):
      id: int
  
  
  class ChildRequest(BaseModel):
      secret: str
      name: str
  
  
  class ChildResponse(BaseModel):
      id: int
      name: str

  # generated by datamodel-codegen:
  #   filename:  session-directional-producers.json
  
  from __future__ import annotations
  from pydantic.dataclasses import dataclass
  from typing import List
  from typing_extensions import TypeAliasType
  
  
  
  @dataclass
  class ARequest:
      name: str
      secret: str
  
  
  
  @dataclass
  class AResponse:
      id: int
      name: str
  
  
  
  @dataclass
  class BRequest:
      name: str
      secret: str
  
  
  
  @dataclass
  class BResponse:
      id: int
      name: str
  
  
  
  ArrayRequest = TypeAliasType("ArrayRequest", List[ARequest])
  
  
  
  ArrayResponse = TypeAliasType("ArrayResponse", List[AResponse])
  
  
  
  @dataclass
  class BaseRequest:
      secret: str
  
  
  
  @dataclass
  class BaseResponse:
      id: int
  
  
  
  @dataclass
  class ChildRequest:
      secret: str
      name: str
  
  
  
  @dataclass
  class ChildResponse:
      id: int
      name: str
